questions.directionKo: 다음 짝지어진 두 단어의 관계가 보기와 같은 것은?

② easy : easily
③ miss : catch
④ tasty : delicious
⑤ bad : badly
questions.explainKo: p.186 보기는 '늦은 : 이른' 반의어이고, ③ miss : catch도 '놓치다 : 잡다' 반의어이다. ①④는 유의어, ②⑤는 형용사 : 부사.

choices: We can talk and eat snacks at the same time. (동시에)
I am able to cook Italian pasta. (할 수 있다)
The general idea of the story is about love. (장군)
The kite is flying high in the air. (공중에)
I like to go out with my friends on weekends. (외출하다)

questions.promptEn:
[05-07] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

G: I hear some exciting music.
B: I can hear it too. Oh, people are playing nongak.
G: What is nongak?
B: (A) ______ traditional Korean music. The performers play many different instruments.
G: Their clothes (B) ______ nice too.
B: Yeah. They even dance and play at the same time. (C) 우리 가서 그들을 구경하는 게 어때?
G: That sounds great!
